query:
INSERT INTO news (slug, title, excerpt, coverImageUrl, blocks, categoryId, date, publishedAt, createdAt)
VALUES (
  'natasha-pierre-great-comet-pioneer-theatre',
  'Assistant Scenic Designer: Natasha, Pierre & The Great Comet of 1812',
  'Supporting Jo Winiarski''s scenic design for the Utah premiere of the electropop opera Natasha, Pierre & The Great Comet of 1812 at Pioneer Theatre Company.',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/VszCxXBODqmeMpQE.jpg',
  '[{"type":"text","content":"Natasha, Pierre & The Great Comet of 1812 brought me to Pioneer Theatre Company to support Jo Winiarski''s scenic design for the Utah premiere of this electropop opera. Nominated for 12 Tony Awards, this Dave Malloy musical adapts a scandalous slice of Tolstoy''s War and Peace into an immersive theatrical experience."},{"type":"header","content":"The Production"},{"type":"text","content":"Directed and choreographed by PTC Artistic Director Karen Azenberg, the production tells the story of young Natasha Rostova who arrives in Moscow to await her fiancé''s return from the front lines. When she falls under the spell of the roguish Anatole, it is up to Pierre, a family friend, to pick up the pieces of her shattered reputation.\\n\\nJo Winiarski''s scenic design created an immersive environment that transformed Pioneer Theatre Company''s traditional proscenium space. The design featured numerous locales within one structure—rich in details and finishes, versatile, and colored in red and gold to evoke imperialist Russia. The set supported the production''s bold storytelling, including eight onstage actor/musicians as part of an overall cast of 20.\\n\\nThe production ran from May 10-25, 2024, and was praised by critics as \\\"both the most innovative and the best new musical to open on Broadway since Hamilton\\\" (The New York Times). The Utah premiere was presented in an immersive format never before seen at PTC, making it one of the most requested titles from audiences in recent memory."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/VszCxXBODqmeMpQE.jpg","caption":"Natasha, Pierre & The Great Comet of 1812 at Pioneer Theatre Company, 2024. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. The immersive set transformed the traditional proscenium space with rich details in red and gold. Photo courtesy Pioneer Theatre Company."},{"type":"header","content":"The Creative Team"},{"type":"team","title":"The Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Dave Malloy","role":"Book, Music & Lyrics"},{"name":"Leo Tolstoy","role":"Based on War and Peace by"},{"name":"Karen Azenberg","role":"Director/Choreographer"},{"name":"Phil Reno","role":"Musical Director/Conductor"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Paul Miller","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Aaron Hubbard","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Patrick Holt","role":"Costume Designer"}]},{"type":"header","content":"About Pioneer Theatre Company"},{"type":"text","content":"Pioneer Theatre Company is Utah''s premier professional theatre in residence at the University of Utah. Under the artistic direction of Karen Azenberg, PTC presents a diverse season of classic and contemporary works, bringing world-class theatre to Salt Lake City audiences."},{"type":"link","url":"https://pioneertheatre.org","label":"Visit Pioneer Theatre Company"}]',
  90002,
  '2024-05-25',
  '2024-05-25',
  NOW()
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  title = VALUES(title),
  excerpt = VALUES(excerpt),
  coverImageUrl = VALUES(coverImageUrl),
  blocks = VALUES(blocks),
  categoryId = VALUES(categoryId),
  date = VALUES(date),
  publishedAt = VALUES(publishedAt);
